final: WITH currency_averages AS (SELECT feecoin, AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_rebate, AVG((rebrate - feerate) / NULLIF(feerate, 0)) AS avg_relative_gap FROM fees GROUP BY feecoin), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rebate) AS value FROM currency_averages) SELECT AVG(avg_rebate) AS mean_rebate, AVG(avg_relative_gap) AS mean_relative_gap, AVG(avg_rebate - value) AS mean_excess_rebate FROM currency_averages CROSS JOIN benchmark WHERE avg_rebate > value
